parsed.note_claim: Blue Origin has not conducted any New Glenn launches or booster landings since April 2026, following a May explosion that suspended operations until late 2026 at earliest.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Blue Origin continues to analyze the explosion of its New Glenn rocket a little more than a month ago, but on Tuesday, CEO Dave Limp shared the company's plan for resuming pad operations later this year.
parsed.reason: The article confirms a New Glenn explosion occurred roughly a month prior to June 30, 2026, and that operations are suspended with plans to resume later in the year.
